change_summary: Added an audit/screen-only script that reruns the current accepted stack, computes day-5/day-10 weak-hold checkpoints, calculates same-sector peer median return from the fixed OHLCV snapshot, and estimates trade-level early-exit PnL for sector-confirmed weak-hold rules. No production strategy code was changed.

delta_metrics.decision_basis: Best effects were tiny and sparse: one late trade and one old trade, no mid triggers, and only trade-level approximation. This is not enough to justify production early-exit implementation.

hypothesis: Price-only weak-hold exits were rejected because weak starts can become delayed winners, and news-confirmed exits were blocked by sparse archives. A deterministic alternative is to require both position weakness and sector-level weakness; if the whole sleeve is deteriorating, early capital release may be less likely to kill idiosyncratic delayed winners.

llm_metrics.blocker_relation: LLM/news was intentionally bypassed after exp-20260425-037 showed news lifecycle coverage was insufficient. This deterministic sector proxy did not improve the weak-hold branch.

market_regime_summary.late_strong: slow-melt bull where one sector-confirmed weak breakout loser was trimmed in approximation
market_regime_summary.mid_weak: rotation-heavy bull with weak+sector-negative checkpoints but no screened trade triggers
market_regime_summary.old_thin: mixed-to-weak tape where one Healthcare breakout loser was trimmed in approximation

next_retry_requires: Do not implement day-5/day-10 sector-confirmed weak-hold exits
Do not retry weak-hold decay by simply adding more deterministic confirmations to the same template
If lifecycle alpha returns, require a truly orthogonal adverse-information source or enough triggered samples for real backtester validation
notes: This was alpha_search, not measurement repair. It changed no production strategy code.

parameters.parity_warning: trade-level approximation only; does not replay freed-slot reinvestment or equity-curve Sharpe
parameters.sector_proxy: median return of same-sector mapped watchlist peers excluding the trade ticker

rejection_reason: Rejected on mechanism quality and sample strength. Sector confirmation does not turn day-5/day-10 weak-hold decay into stable alpha; it only trims two small losers in approximation.
